name: Shanghai STEP Electric Corporation
summary: Shanghai Step Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture and sale of industrial automation control products. It also manufactures and sells elevator control systems and components. Its products include industrial robots, welding robot, handling robot, automotive production solutions, elevators and escalator control cabinet, elevator control board, IAStar elevator inverter, 32-bit network ISmartCom elevator computer, elevator group control system, elevator monitoring system, elevator control system extension device, industrial drive, push buttons, wires, cables and other industrial automation components. The company was founded on March 10, 1995 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
